source.name: The 14 flat rewrite-edit items ported verbatim plus a 14-item CONSTRAINT-PRESERVATION tier (rwh-01..14) targeting the measured failure mode: silent constraint-dropping. Each new rubric carries the explicit checklist (verbatim tokens, caps warnings, quoted material, redaction markers, numbers-that-look-wrong-but-are-right); rubric-anchored judging — the judge sees the answer key. must-preserve tokens script-verified verbatim against each source text.
